about: Every game system the mashup touches, where it hooks in, and which code owns it.

rows.system: World open/create on launch, join friend
Open to LAN on load (e4mc link), Melty join/host log lines
Hub + obby build, spawn point, game rules
Match state machine, storm, bots fill, victory
Shield absorbs damage; storm damage
Elimination instead of death in a match / hub
Guns and consumables
Bot entity and AI
Server to client state (storm, shield, media, sounds, emotes)
Players and bots drawn as Roblox R6 avatars
Fortnite-style HUD: minimap, stats row, storm banner, HP/shield, ammo + reserve, bus prompt, locked slots
Parked Battle Bus + splash billboard in the hub, storm wall in matches (no cinematics)
Roblox sounds and Fortnite soundtracks (hub music, storm music) streamed from memory
Roblox jump/land/footstep sounds
Camera always third person over the right shoulder, like Fortnite; F5 cannot switch it (scoped sniper looks through the scope)
Battle Bus jump (Space), skydive and glider physics
Pickaxe + 5 item slots, ammo-only inventory, locked hotbar slots
Structure chests (villages, ruined portals, ...) roll Fortnite loot
Game always starts borderless fullscreen
rows.hook: ClientLifecycleEvents.CLIENT_STARTED -> options fullscreen on, exclusive off

rows.system: Fortnite harvesting: ground unbreakable, trees fall whole, house walls/roofs fall by section, materials
rows.hook: AttackBlockCallback (stop mining unbreakables) + PlayerBlockBreakEvents.BEFORE (collapse) + pickaxe Tool component

rows.system: Crafting disabled
rows.hook: gamerule limited_crafting + all recipes removed from players

rows.system: Reload, emote menu, back to hub
